Apache-2.0 is OSI-approved, so this slot qualifies as open-source as well as open-weight. Quantisation F16. Served self-hosted via llama.cpp on VT ARC Falcon node fal039:53013 over an SSH tunnel on localhost:8083; no third-party inference provider.
